sql:
SELECT cls, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, AVG(yt) as avg_yt_per_trip 
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 60 AND fish_date_doy <= 92
GROUP BY cls 
ORDER BY total_yt DESC
